Only a few design partners get access at first. The first part, phase 1 (chart builder and saved views), opens as a design-partner beta on Wednesday, Dec 9, for 5 customers. Those are Orbitly, Zest Grocers and three accounts from the October trial cohort [3].

Other customers won't get access before general availability, which is targeted for late January [3]. The Pinecrest Logistics prospect has asked for beta access during its evaluation. Sam Ortiz told them he'd check [5].

The Dec 9 date comes from the Nov 16 project update, which says the work is on track. Earlier sources were vaguer. The spec said "early December" [2], and the Nov 12 sync said phase 1 should be feature-complete by Dec 4, with the beta right after [1]. Two items were still open on Nov 16: query performance on workspaces above 50M events, and empty states [3].
